claims.statement: The token endpoint returns an access_token described as the bearer access token used to authenticate to Canva REST API endpoints, and the authentication guide says access tokens are valid only for a short period.

sources.supports: access_token string The bearer access token to use to authenticate to Canva REST API endpoints.
Because access tokens are only valid for a short period time, you can handle requesting new access tokens using a refresh token

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: No prefix, length or alphabet is stated by the pages read; the documentation example values are not copied here and the token is treated as opaque. Whether a Canva access token can be told apart from other opaque tokens by shape alone is unresolved. The candidate is not researched beyond existence.
